# HouseholdLedger Repository Guardrails

- Treat HouseholdLedger as the product repository. When `BudgetExperiment/` is present, use it only as read-only reference material unless the user explicitly requests an exact operation there.
- Build HouseholdLedger as a curated successor with fresh implementation. Reuse validated lessons, domain concepts, workflows, edge cases, and test scenarios deliberately; do not port the old architecture or accumulated complexity by default.
- Retain .NET and Blazor as the technology baseline while designing from current requirements and first principles.
- Keep Kakeibo and the calendar-centered household ledger as the product direction. Ask before making a material product-direction change; routine implementation choices do not need separate approval.
- Treat the custom agents as optional specialist tools. Use them when their focused context will improve a complex task, but do not require orchestration, exclusive ownership plans, dedicated terminals, retained audits, or multi-agent handoffs for ordinary work.
- Manage dependencies proportionately under `docs/development/dependency-governance.md`. Routine, well-known FOSS package and tool changes may proceed with normal manifest review, lock-file inspection, and focused validation. Ask first only when a dependency has unclear licensing or provenance, meaningful security or privacy implications, a paid-service commitment, substantial operational cost, or an unusually broad runtime footprint.
- Apply security and privacy review in proportion to the change. Escalate decisions that affect sensitive data, authentication, authorization, secret handling, or accepted risk; ordinary secure implementation and test fixes do not require a separate acceptance record.
- Never expose secrets, credentials, tokens, connection strings, personal data, or sensitive command output.
- Do not perform destructive operations, modify remote systems, or commit, push, merge, rebase, publish, release, or change branches unless the user explicitly requests the exact action.
- Run the narrowest focused executable validation that can establish the change. Report exact results and state unavailable checks, failures, uncertainty, and residual risk truthfully.
